title: Stochastic Multipath Routing for High-Throughput Entanglement Distribution in Quantum Repeater Networks
summary: Quantum repeater networks distribute entanglement over lossy links while many users share a limited pool of entangled pairs. Most existing routing schemes either always use a single best path or rely on global optimizations that are hard to run in real time. Here we propose and analyze a simple alternative: a stochastic multipath rule in which each entanglement request is sent at random along one of several edge-disjoint repeater paths, with a single parameter that controls the bias between shorter and longer routes.
